about.title: Khaldon Gamil. Exchange and transfers, with a human touch.
about.text: We help individuals and businesses exchange currencies and arrange outgoing and incoming transfers. Our team explains available options, costs, and requirements before you confirm. Contact us on WhatsApp or visit our Sana’a office. We provide exchange and financial intermediary services, not banking, an app, or bank accounts.

items.q: How do I request a service?
items.a: Contact us on WhatsApp or visit our office with the destination, amount, and currency. Our team explains available options and requirements before confirmation.
Explore the destinations section, then contact us to confirm availability and delivery options for your specific request.

items.q: How are rates and fees determined?
items.a: Our team provides the exchange rate, fees, and expected payout based on the destination, currency, and delivery method before you agree to proceed.

items.q: How long does a transfer take?
items.a: Timing depends on the destination, delivery method, and processing requirements. We explain the expected timeframe when reviewing your request.

items.q: Do I need an app or a new account?
items.a: We do not offer an app or bank accounts. Contact our team to start; information or documents may be required for your transaction.
